tasks.instruction: Match each description (A-L) to the correct place. Three descriptions do not match any of them.

options.text: Much of the ground here stays frozen all the year round.
For weeks in summer the sun does not set, and for weeks in winter it does not rise.
A very large share of the world's plant and animal species live here.
Animals here often have a thick layer of fat and pale fur to survive the cold.
The temperature can swing from very hot by day to near freezing at night.
This is the deepest part of the ocean, where no sunlight reaches at all.
Coral grows in the warm shallow water here.
It rains here on most days of the year and the air is always damp.
Less than 250 millimetres of rain falls here in an average year.
Farmers here grow rice in flooded fields.
Many of its animals stay underground during the day and come out after dark.
The tall trees form a thick roof of leaves that keeps the ground below in shade.
